q1.text: What would you like to improve first?
q1.help: Choose what matters most to you today. We’ll refine the details later.

color_tipo.text: How would you describe the color of your teeth?

options.oscuro: One tooth darker than the others

color_meta.text: What result would you like for the color of your teeth?

options.natural: A lighter shade that still looks natural
options.luminosa: A whiter, even and brighter smile
options.alta: A high-aesthetic white with a visible change
options.manchas: Correcting stains or color differences between my teeth

color_forma.text: Would you also like to change the shape or size?

esp_zona.text: Where in your smile are the gaps?

options.centrales: Between the two upper front teeth
options.ambas: In both arches, upper and lower
options.falta: I have a gap because one or more teeth are missing

options.visibles: Visible when I talk or smile

forma_tipo.text: What would you like to correct about the shape of your teeth?

options.cortos: My teeth look short or worn
options.largos: Some teeth are longer than others
options.simetria: I want a more symmetrical, harmonious smile

pos_grado.text: How would you describe the position of your teeth?

options.girados: Some teeth are rotated or stick out
options.mordida: I feel my bite doesn’t fit correctly

options.sin_brackets: A visually straighter smile without braces
options.mejorar: Improve the alignment and look of my teeth
options.alineadores: Correct the position of my teeth with aligners
options.evalue: I’d like the medical team to assess the best option

options.pocos: One or two broken or heavily restored teeth
options.general: Wear on almost all of my teeth

desg_preocupa.text: What worries you most about your worn or fractured teeth?

options.forma: Restoring their original shape and size
options.resistencia: Restoring the strength of my teeth
options.completa: I need a complete aesthetic and functional rehabilitation

desg_sintomas.text: Do you have any of these symptoms?
desg_sintomas.help: Choose the one closest to your case.

falt_cuantos.text: How many natural teeth are you missing?

options.todos: All teeth in one or both arches

falt_actual.text: Do you currently use anything to replace those teeth?

options.implantes: Yes, one or more dental implants
options.combinacion: A combination of implants and dentures

falt_reemplazados.text: How many teeth have been replaced with dentures or implants?

falt_zona.text: Where are the missing or replaced teeth?

falt_pref.text: What kind of solution would you like?

options.fija: A fixed solution I don’t have to remove
options.reemplazar: Replace my current denture with a more comfortable option
options.rehab_fija: Restore all my teeth with a fixed rehabilitation
options.recomendacion: I’d rather get a professional recommendation

varias_enfoque.text: What are you mainly looking for?

cantidad.text: How many teeth visible when you smile would you like to improve?

prioridad.text: What matters most to you in transforming your smile?
prioridad.help: It helps us understand your preferences. The clinical indication is defined at your assessment.

options.natural: A natural, aesthetic and harmonious result
options.una_cita: Getting my treatment done in a single visit
options.conservar: Preserving as much natural tooth structure as possible
options.doctora: I’d like the medical team to recommend the best option

viaje.text: When would you like to travel to Cancun?
viaje.help: It helps us prepare your assessment in time.

agenda.text: Would you like to book a personalized assessment?

options.dudas: Yes, but I have a few questions first

directas.name: Smile design with direct veneers
directas.desc: Transform the color, shape and harmony of your smile with a conservative technique that, in suitable cases, can be done in a single visit.

ceramicas.name: Smile design with ceramic veneers
ceramicas.desc: A high-aesthetic option with strength and color stability, designed for natural, personalized results.

alineadores.name: Clear aligners
alineadores.desc: Gradually improve the position of your teeth with a personalized orthodontic treatment.

rehabilitacion.name: Personalized dental rehabilitation
rehabilitacion.desc: Restore the shape, strength and function of your teeth with restorations adapted to your needs.

implantes.name: Dental implants and prosthetic rehabilitation
implantes.desc: Replace missing teeth with fixed or removable solutions, based on your clinical condition.

protesis.name: Custom dentures
protesis.desc: Get your smile back and eat comfortably with a denture made for you, based on your clinical condition.

allon4.name: Full-mouth rehabilitation
allon4.desc: Explore complete dentures and fixed rehabilitations on implants, including All-on-4 and All-on-6 when indicated.

valoracion.name: Comprehensive aesthetic and oral rehabilitation assessment
valoracion.desc: We’ll design a personalized plan to restore the look, function and harmony of your smile.

blanqueamiento.name: Teeth whitening
blanqueamiento.desc: Lightens the natural shade of your teeth when indicated. It does not change their shape, size or position.

cta: Your smile deserves a personalized design. Book your assessment with our medical team and find out which treatment can help you get the result you want.
